lines.t: Fire in His eyes, justice burning bright,
Wisdom roars across the mountain height.
Every heart shakes when His Word is heard,
The Lion speaks, and the nations stir.
All creation moves when His thunder rolls,
Truth pours down, reviving souls.
He is The Lion — mighty and pure,
The voice of mercy, faithful and sure.
From the dawn to the setting sun,
The volumes speak — His work is done.
Rivers of light flow from His hand,
He raises the humble to make them stand.
No shadow can hide from His holy flame,
The Lion reigns; His Word remains.
Songs rise up from the earth below,
Peace like rain begins to flow.
He is The Lion — mighty and pure,
The voice of mercy, faithful and sure.
From the dawn to the setting sun,
The volumes speak — His work is done.
From desert winds to the ocean wide,
His truth is the banner that none can hide.
He calls the seekers; He heals the blind,
In The Lion’s roar, love is defined.
He is The Lion — justice and peace,
Power eternal that shall not cease.
Every word that He’s spoken rings,
From The Volumes, the truth still sings.
Let the roots rise, and the truth unfold,
The Lion of Light, His story told.
